entries.subject: Orbit
entries.finding: Denis et al. (2026), arXiv:2602.10260, VLT/HiRISE radial velocities with published astrometry.

entries.subject: A false color from three measured bands
entries.finding: Shown in infrared false color from its measured flux in MKO K 2.184 µm, MKO H 1.614 µm, MKO J 1.2417 µm (Rajan et al. (2017), as compiled in Best, Liu, Magnier & Dupuy (2024), The UltracoolSheet v2.1 (Zenodo); zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law fitted to the MKO H intensity PICASO 4.1 (Batalha et al. 2019, ApJ 878, 70) computes from Exo-REM cloudy (Charnay et al. 2018, ApJ 854, 172; 3.16 times solar metallicity, C/O 0.65) model atmospheres at 632 K and log g 3.7, read between the models YGP_600K_logg3.5, YGP_600K_logg4.0, YGP_650K_logg3.5, YGP_650K_logg4.0 (u1 1.237, u2 -0.291; the law fits each model's eight angles within 0.33% of the centre): a cloudy model, the one Balmer et al. (2025), arXiv:2503.13608 fit to this planet, because no table reaches a planet this cold and nobody has resolved its disc. The temperature and gravity are that fit's (Section IV.2.2, the best-fit Exo-REM model with informative priors on the mass and radius: Teff 632 +/- 13 K, log g 3.7 +/- 0.3, radius 1.30 +/- 0.03, [Fe/H] 0.65 +/- 0.15, C/O 0.65 +0.05/-0.08; [record](source/photometry/atmosphere-fit.json)), not the 800 K of its measurements record. Another fit (Madurowicz et al. 2025, the temperature on record) uses Sonora Elf Owl models with patchy clouds its authors computed and did not release, so no law can be computed from it.
